speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a postmenopausal woman presenting with vaginal bleeding and an adnexal mass; to determine the cause, are you experiencing any pain, fever, or changes in your menstrual cycle prior to menopause?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits. No previous history of similar symptoms. She has no history of serious illness and takes no medications regularly.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial hyperplasia or endometrial carcinoma (primary differential). I have established the core clinical picture; further testing is not required to make this initial diagnosis based on the classic presentation of postmenopausal bleeding with an adnexal mass. However, to confirm the etiology and guide treatment, please proceed immediately with an Endometrial_Biopsy and Transvaginal_Ultrasound.
